source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', including revoked ones), restricted to this part: Parte Especial Títulos VI–IX — dignidade sexual, família, incolumidade pública, paz pública, arts. 213–288-A. Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles, and an article's paragraphs, incisos and alíneas are within its unit.
source.enumeration_note: This file is ONE PART of the roadmap (g4-dignidade-incolumidade); the conductor merges the six parts (and the ontology pass's claims) into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete: 434 units, every article number 1–361 present.
